import hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
r=Path('experiments/results/inten_geometric_prior');root=Path('/tmp/localization-zoo-inten-geometric-prior-20261023')
source=root/'recovery_raw/01/dataset/sequences/01/velodyne';target=root/'raw/01/dataset/sequences/01/velodyne'
manifest=Path('/workspace/localization-env/branch-cleanup-20261022/worktree/experiments/results/inten_facade_pca/sequences/01/inputs.json')
pins=json.loads(manifest.read_text())['files'];count=sum(n.endswith('.bin') for n in pins)
rows=[]
for i in range(960,count):
    name=f'{i:06d}.bin';data=(source/name).read_bytes();digest=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    assert digest==pins[name]['sha256'] and len(data)==pins[name]['bytes'],name
    rows.append(dict(name=name,sha256=digest,bytes=len(data)))
binary=json.loads((r/'binaries.json').read_text())
actual=subprocess.check_output(['docker','exec','localization-zoo-dev','sha256sum',binary['runner_container_path']],text=True).split()[0]
assert actual==binary['runner_sha256']
target.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
for row in rows:
    (source/row['name']).replace(target/row['name'])
    assert hashlib.sha256((target/row['name']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==row['sha256']
print(json.dumps(dict(all_inputs_valid=True,manifest_sha256=hashlib.sha256(manifest.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),binary_sha256=actual,staged_inputs=rows),indent=2))
